story.text: Croquet with the Queen is a curious game: the {BALLS} are live {HEDGEHOGS}, the mallets live {FLAMINGOS}, and the soldiers double themselves up to make the {ARCHES}. The Queen shouts “Off with his head!” about once in a minute. Then the Cheshire Cat’s {HEAD} appears in the air, and the executioner, the King and the Queen all {ARGUE}: can you cut off a head with no {BODY}?
story.caption: The Cheshire Cat’s head, over the croquet-ground
